rationale: Beat EPS ($1.40 vs $1.29). Raised 2026 operating income target by ~$50M to $965M-$1.04B ($6 EPS at bottom with zero market growth). New $2B buyback over 3 years plus existing 4.5M shares. 7 consecutive quarters of outperformance; NAST volume +3% vs Cass -7.2%. 39% adjusted operating margin in NAST at/near mid-cycle target. Management confident and specific on AI productivity, Agentic AI waves, moats (people, tech, operating model). Caveats: Global Forwarding challenged (ocean AGP/shipment -27.5%, will continue into Q1 26), Q4 seasonally weaker, truckload rate recovery slower than expected. Strong structural story with modest near-term headwind — momentum likely continues.

Big EPS beat ($0.67 vs $0.53, +91% YoY). Revenue $1.22B above high end of guide. Record quarterly orders considerably above revenue. Two 10% customers. 18-24 month technology lead with WaveLogic 6 and RLS. Interconnect revenue doubling in 2025 and expected to 'at least double and more' in FY26. Pulled forward long-term 15-16% operating margin target by one year to 2026. Preliminary FY26 guide of 17% growth; gross margin expanding to 43% +/- 1pt. Hundreds of millions ramping on dedicated AI training cluster wins. Massive visible TAM ($7T AI infrastructure through 2030). Strategic R&D reallocation away from residential broadband (non-core) is disciplined focus, not distress. Strong conviction momentum continues.

Missed EPS significantly ($3.86 vs $4.83 expected, ~20% miss). $240M noncash Accelera/electrolyzer charges with strategic review and 'may be further charges.' Heavy-duty truck production -34% industry, Cummins shipments -38%. Medium-duty -51%. Guiding another 15% Q4 decline in engine shipments. No 2026 guidance until February. Hedging language throughout: 'cautiously optimistic,' 'I hope demand is close to bottoming,' 'sharpest decline in truck orders many here have witnessed.' Sharp and dramatic revenue decline in electrolyzers. Power systems/data center bright spot (+18% revenue, 22.9% EBITDA) but can't offset broader weakness. Tariff pressure ongoing. Defensive Q&A tone with multiple 'we need more details' responses on Section 232. More negative than positive — momentum likely reverses.

Record quarter: retail units +44% to 155,941, revenue +55% to $5.65B, adj EBITDA +$208M to $637M (11.3% margin, 2x industry). Q4 guide: units above 150K and FY25 EBITDA at or above high end of $2-2.2B range. GAAP op income +$215M, a record. Debt reduction of $1.2B over 2024-25; net debt/EBITDA 1.5x, strongest ever. Loan book performing well; Ally upsized $4B to $6B, two new $4B loan purchase agreements with partners. Confident management tone, specific on Phoenix same-day delivery test (40% vs 10% nationwide). Concerns: Q3-to-Q4 retail unit guide flat-to-down vs historical sequential growth; subprime loan worries sector-wide; valuation already rich with strong momentum priced in. GPU pressure from depreciation. Fundamentally positive but Q4 unit guide and subprime concerns prevent a 5. Momentum likely continues.

Beat EPS ($2.59 vs $2.47, +17% YoY). Record revenue ($27B +11%), record AI orders ($12.3B, $30B YTD), record AI backlog ($18.4B). Q4 guide implies revenue +32%, EPS +31% to $9.92 FY26 (+22%, well above long-term framework). AI server shipments expected $9.4B in Q4 alone — nearly as much as all of prior year. 5-quarter pipeline multiples of backlog. ISG operating margin +360bps sequentially to 12.4%. Storage Dell IP strong (PowerStore 7 consecutive quarters double-digit). Strong FY27 confidence with EPS framework starting point at mid-teens growth. Traditional server demand accelerating. PC refresh durable (500M units not upgraded to Win11). Risk: commodity/DRAM supply constraints called 'unprecedented' — but direct model, long-term supply agreements, ability to reprice faster than norm (>2/3 recovery in 90 days). Mix shifting to GB300. Highly confident, specific, diverse customer base (NeoClouds, sovereigns, enterprise). Strong conviction momentum continues.
